headings: Other Matters Relating to Our Business as a Whole
paragraphs: Crane Company has delivered innovation and technology-led solutions for customers since its founding in 1855. Today, Crane is a leading manufacturer of highly engineered components for challenging, mission-critical applications focused on the aerospace, defense, space and process industry end markets. The Company has two reporting segments: Aerospace & Advanced Technologies ("AAT") and Process Flow Technologies ("PFT").

We have been committed to the highest standards of business conduct since our inception in 1855 when our founder, R.T. Crane, resolved "to conduct my business in the strictest honesty and fairness; to avoid all deception and trickery; to deal fairly with both customers and competitors; to be liberal and just toward employees; and to put my whole mind upon the business."

Our strategy is to grow earnings and cash flow by focusing on the development and manufacturing of highly engineered industrial products for specific markets where our scale is a relative advantage, and where we can compete based on our proprietary and differentiated technology, our deep vertical expertise, and our responsiveness to unique and diverse customer needs. We continuously evaluate our portfolio, pursue acquisitions that complement our existing businesses and selectively divest businesses where appropriate. We strive to foster a performance-based culture focused on productivity and continuous improvement, to attract and retain a committed management team whose interests are directly aligned with those of our shareholders, and to maintain a focused and efficient corporate structure.

We operate a comprehensive set of business processes, philosophies and operational excellence tools to drive continuous improvement throughout our businesses (collectively, the Crane Business System). Beginning with a core value of integrity, we incorporate "Voice of the Customer" learnings (specific processes designed to capture our customers' requirements) and a broad range of tools into a disciplined strategy deployment process to continuously improve safety, quality, delivery, cost and growth. An embedded intellectual capital development process helps ensure that we attract, develop, promote and retain the right talent to drive continuity and repeatable results.
Acquisition of Druck, Panametrics and Reuter-Stokes
On January 1, 2026, the Company completed the acquisition of the Druck, Panametrics and Reuter-Stokes brands (previously known as Precision Sensors & Instrumentation) from the Baker Hughes Company.

Druck, Panametrics and Reuter-Stokes are all leading providers of sensor-based technologies for aerospace, nuclear and process industries. The Druck brand is being integrated into the Aerospace & Advanced Technologies segment. Panametrics and Reuter-Stokes brands are being integrated into the Process Flow Technologies segment.

Also on January 1, 2026, the Company completed the acquisition of optek-Danulat ("Optek"). Optek is a leading provider of inline process control optical measurement solutions for biopharma, pharmaceutical and other demanding markets. Optek is being integrated into the Process Flow Technologies segment.

On January 1, 2025, the Company completed the sale of the Engineered Materials segment. The Engineered Materials segment met the criteria of being reported as a discontinued operation as of December 31, 2024. As a result, the related assets, liabilities and operating results of Engineered Materials are presented as discontinued operations and, as such, have been excluded from both continuing operations and segment results for all periods presented. Throughout this Annual Report on Form 10-K, unless otherwise indicated, amounts and activity are presented on a continuing operations basis. See Item 8 under Note 3, "Discontinued Operations," in the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements for additional details.

On November 1, 2024, the Company completed the acquisition of Technifab Products, Inc. ("Technifab"). Technifab is a leading provider of vacuum insulated pipe systems and valves for cryogenic applications. Technifab has been integrated into the Process Flow Technologies segment.

On May 1, 2024, the Company completed the acquisition of CryoWorks, Inc. ("CryoWorks"). CryoWorks is a leading supplier of vacuum insulated pipe systems for hydrogen and cryogenic applications. CryoWorks has been integrated into the Process Flow Technologies segment.

On January 2, 2024, the Company completed the acquisition of Vian Enterprises, Inc. ("Vian"). Vian is a global designer and manufacturer of multi-stage lubrication pumps and lubrication system components technology for critical aerospace and defense applications with sole-sourced and proprietary content on the highest volume commercial and military aircraft platforms. Vian has been integrated into the Aerospace & Advanced Technologies segment.

On October 4, 2023, the Company completed the acquisition of Baum lined piping GmbH ("BAUM"). BAUM is a German based company that designs, manufactures, and distributes lined piping products primarily focused on chemical and industrial end markets. BAUM has been integrated into our Process Flow Technologies segment.

On April 3, 2023, Crane Holdings, Co. completed the Separation into two independent, publicly-traded companies, Crane NXT, Co. and Crane Company (the "Separation"), through a pro-rata distribution (the "Distribution") of all of the outstanding common stock of Crane Company to the stockholders of Crane Holdings, Co., which on April 3, 2023 was renamed "Crane NXT, Co." As a result of the Distribution, Crane Company became an independent public company. Our common stock is listed under the symbol "CR" on the New York Stock Exchange. Due to Crane Company's larger operations, greater tangible assets, greater fair value and greater net sales, in each case, relative to Crane NXT, Co., among other factors, Crane Company was treated as the "accounting spinnor" and therefore was the "accounting successor" to Crane Holdings, Co. for accounting purposes, notwithstanding the legal form of the Separation. Therefore, following the Separation, the historical consolidated financial statements of Crane Company reflect the historical consolidated financial statements of Crane Holdings, Co. with the Payment & Merchandising Technologies segment and other distributed assets and liabilities classified as discontinued operations.

headings: Macroeconomic fluctuations may harm our business, results of operations and stock price.
Demand for our products is variable and subject to factors beyond our control, which could result in unanticipated events significantly impacting our results of operations.
We conduct a substantial portion of our business outside the U.S. and face risks inherent in non-domestic operations.
We may be unable to identify or to complete acquisitions, or to successfully integrate the businesses we acquire.
Our ability to source components and raw materials from our suppliers could be disrupted or delayed in our supply chain, which could adversely affect our results of operations.
The prices of our components and raw materials could fluctuate dramatically, which may adversely affect our profitability.
We face significant competition which may adversely impact our financial condition, results of operations, and cash flows in the future.

Our businesses are subject to extensive governmental regulation; failure to comply with those regulations could adversely affect our financial condition, results of operations, cash flows and reputation.
Our business could be harmed if we are unable to protect our intellectual property.
Our future results of operations and financial condition could be adversely impacted by intangible asset impairment charges.

Our operations expose us to the risk of environmental liabilities, costs, litigation and violations that could adversely affect our financial condition, results of operations, cash flows and reputation.

We could face potential product liability or warranty claims, we may not accurately estimate costs related to such claims, and we may not have sufficient insurance coverage available to cover such claims.
Fluctuations in interest rates could affect our financial results.
We may be unable to improve productivity, reduce costs and align manufacturing capacity with customer demand.
Additional tax expense or exposures could affect our financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.
If our internal controls are found to be ineffective, our financial results or our stock price may be adversely affected.

Net periodic pension cost and pension contributions associated with our retirement benefit plans may fluctuate significantly depending upon changes in actuarial assumptions and future market performance of plan assets.
Specific Risks Relating to Our Reportable Segments
paragraphs: Our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows may be affected by a number of factors including, but not limited to those set forth below. This discussion should be considered in conjunction with the discussion under the caption "Forward-Looking Information" preceding Part I, the information set forth under Item 1, "Business" and with the discussion of the business included in Part II, Item 7, "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations." These risks comprise the material risks of which we are aware. If any of the events or developments described below or elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, or in any documents that we subsequently file publicly were to occur, it could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.

Our business, financial condition, operating results and cash flows may be adversely affected by changes in global economic conditions and geopolitical risks, including credit market conditions, trade policies, including recently announced and potential additional tariffs on certain raw materials, levels of consumer and business confidence, commodity prices and availability, inflationary pressures, exchange rates, levels of government spending and deficits, political conditions, and other challenges that could affect the global economy, including the ongoing conflict in the Middle East as well as impacts associated with any economic sanctions imposed against Russia, in response to their invasion of the Ukraine. These economic and geopolitical conditions could affect businesses such as ours in a number of ways. Such conditions could have an adverse impact on our flexibility to react to changing economic and business conditions and on our ability to fund our operations, grow through operations or refinance maturing debt balances at economically favorable interest rates. In addition, restrictions on credit availability could adversely affect the ability of our customers to obtain financing for significant purchases and could result in decreases in or cancellation of orders for our products and services as well as impact the ability of our customers to make payments. Similarly, credit restrictions may adversely affect our supplier base and increase the potential for one or more of our suppliers to experience financial distress or bankruptcy. See "Specific Risks Related to Our Reportable Segments."

A substantial portion of our sales is subject to market conditions which may cause customer demand for our products to fluctuate. Reductions in demand from these industries would reduce the sales and profitability of the affected business segments.

•In our Aerospace & Advanced Technologies segment, a significant decline in demand for air travel, or a decline in airline profitability generally, could result in reduced orders for aircraft and could also cause airlines to reduce their purchases of spare parts from our businesses. In addition, our Aerospace & Advanced Technologies segment could be impacted to the extent that our major aircraft manufacturing customers encounter problems which impact their production rates and, correspondingly, reduce purchases of our products, or if pricing pressure from aircraft customers caused the manufacturers to press their suppliers to lower prices and/or extend payment terms; in addition, demand for military and defense products is dependent upon government spending in certain areas which can vary year to year.

•Our Process Flow Technologies segment is dependent on global economic conditions, customer capital spending and commodity prices. Deterioration in any of these economic factors could result in sales and profits falling below our current outlook.
•Ongoing or threatened U.S. government shutdowns which may impact our ability to obtain or progress on government contracts, primarily in our Aerospace and Advanced Technologies segment.

headings: 與本公司整體業務相關的其他事項
paragraphs: Crane Company 自1855年成立以來，一直為客戶提供以創新與科技為導向的解決方案。今日，Crane 是一家在航空、防禦、太空及流程工業等終端市場中，專注於高工程化零組件的領導製造商。本公司有兩個應報告分部：航空與先進科技（"AAT"）及流程流體科技（"PFT"）。
自1855年成立以來，我們始終致力於維持最高的商業操守標準。當我們的創辦人 R.T. Crane 確立公司時，他決心 "以最嚴謹的誠實與公平來經營業務；避免所有欺詐與詐欺行為；以公平的態度對待客戶與競爭對手；對員工寬厚與公正；並將全部心力投入業務。"

我們的策略是透過專注於特定市場的高工程化工業產品的開發與製造，來增加營業收入與現金流。這些市場中，我們的規模相對具有優勢，且我們能以專屬且差異化的技術、深厚的垂直專業知識，以及對獨特且多樣客戶需求的快速反應來競爭。我們持續評估我們的業務組合，追求與現有業務相輔相成的併購，並在適當的情況下選擇性地出售業務。我們致力於建立以績效為導向的文化，重視生產力與持續改善，以吸引並留住忠誠的管理團隊，其利益與股東的利益直接對應，並維持一個專注且高效的企業架構。

我們運作一套完整的業務流程、哲學與運營卓越工具，以推動我們業務的持續改善（ collectively，Crane Business System）。從核心價值觀的誠信開始，我們將 "客戶聲音" 的學習成果（專門設計以捕捉客戶需求的流程）與廣泛的工具整合至一個嚴謹的策略落實流程中，持續改善安全、品質、交貨、成本與成長。內建的智慧財產權發展流程有助於確保我們吸引、培訓、晉升並留住合適的人才，以推動持續性與可重複的成果。
收購 Druck、Panametrics 與 Reuter-Stokes
於2026年1月1日，本公司完成了對 Druck、Panametrics 與 Reuter-Stokes 品牌（先前稱為 Precision Sensors & Instrumentation）自 Baker Hughes Company 的收購。
Druck、Panametrics 與 Reuter-Stokes 都是航空、核能與流程工業中以感測器為基礎的科技領導供應商。Druck 品牌將被整合至航空與先進科技分部。Panametrics 與 Reuter-Stokes 品牌將被整合至流程流體科技分部。
同時於2026年1月1日，本公司完成了對 optek-Danulat（"Optek"）的收購。Optek 是生物製藥、製藥及其他嚴苛市場中，提供線上流程控制光學測量解決方案的領導供應商。Optek 將被整合至流程流體科技分部。

於2025年1月1日，本公司完成將Engineered Materials應報告分部出售。Engineered Materials應報告分部符合截至2024年12月31日應列為已終止營運的條件。因此，與Engineered Materials應報告分部相關的資產、負債及營運結果，均列為已終止營運，並已從所有期間的持續營運及分部結果中剔除。本年度報表（Form 10-K）中，除非另有說明，所有金額及活動均以持續營運為基礎呈現。有關更多細節，請參見第8項註釋第3點「已終止營運」。
於2024年11月1日，本公司完成對Technifab Products, Inc.（"Technifab"）的收購。Technifab為真空絕熱管系統及閥門的主要供應商，專門用於低溫應用。Technifab已整合至Process Flow Technologies應報告分部。
於2024年5月1日，本公司完成對CryoWorks, Inc.（"CryoWorks"）的收購。CryoWorks為氫氣及低溫應用的真空絕熱管系統的主要供應商。CryoWorks已整合至Process Flow Technologies應報告分部。
於2024年1月2日，本公司完成對Vian Enterprises, Inc.（"Vian"）的收購。Vian為全球知名的多階段潤滑泵及潤滑系統零組件技術設計與製造商，專門用於關鍵的航空與防禦應用，並在最高用量的商業及軍用飛機平台上擁有獨家來源及專利技術。Vian已整合至Aerospace & Advanced Technologies應報告分部。
於2023年10月4日，本公司完成對BAUM lined piping GmbH（"BAUM"）的收購。BAUM為德國公司，專門設計、製造及銷售用於化學及工業終端市場的包覆管產品。BAUM已整合至Process Flow Technologies應報告分部。

於2023年4月3日，Crane Holdings, Co.完成分拆為兩家獨立上市的公司，Crane NXT, Co.與Crane Company（"分拆"），透過按持股比例發放（"發放"）Crane Company所有流通普通股給Crane Holdings, Co.股東，該公司於2023年4月3日更名為"Crane NXT, Co."。因此，Crane Company成為一家獨立上市的公司。本公司普通股於紐約證券交易所上市，代號為"CR"。由於Crane Company的營運規模、實質資產、公允價值及淨銷售額，均較Crane NXT, Co.為大，因此在其他因素考量下，Crane Company被視為"會計繼承者"，因此在會計處理上為Crane Holdings, Co.的"會計繼承者"，儘管分拆的法律形式為分拆。因此，分拆後，Crane Company的歷史合併財務報表反映Crane Holdings, Co.的歷史合併財務報表，並將Payment & Merchandising Technologies應報告分部及其他分發的資產與負債歸類為已終止營運。

我們的策略是透過專注於特定市場的高精度工業產品開發與製造，來提升營業收入與現金流。這些市場中，我們的規模具有相對優勢，且我們能透過專屬且差異化的技術、深厚的垂直專業知識，以及對獨特且多樣客戶需求的快速回應來競爭。我們持續評估產品組合，尋求能與現有業務補充且對成長有貢獻的併購，適當時機進行合適的資產處置，並透過內部併購來提升效率。我們致力於建立以績效為導向的文化，重視生產力與持續改善，以吸引並留住與股東利益完全一致的管理團隊，並維持一個專注且高效的企業架構。
我們將持續執行此策略，同時堅守創辦人R.T. Crane所秉持的價值觀，即「以最嚴謹的誠實與公平進行業務；避免所有欺詐與詐欺行為；對客戶與競爭對手皆公平對待；對員工寬厚且公正；並將全部心力投入於業務。」
本報告中提及的「核心銷售」或「核心成長」變動，包含銷售額及銷售變動，排除外幣換算的影響，以及自交易完成日起至第一個週年慶之間的併購與處置的影響。
由於四捨五入的關係，本報告中所呈現的數字可能無法完全加總至我們提供的總額，百分比也可能無法完全反映實際數字。

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
總體經濟波動可能損害我們的業務、營業成果與股票價格。
我們產品的需求具有變動性，且受制於我們無法控制的因素，這可能會導致未預期的事件，對我們的營業成果造成重大影響。
我們在美國境外進行業務的比重相當高，並面臨非美國運營固有的風險。

paragraphs: 本公司之業務、財務狀況、營運成果及現金流可能受多項因素影響，包括但不限於下列所列因素。此討論應與第一部分標題為「前瞻性資訊」之說明、第一項目「業務」所載資訊，以及第二部分第七項目「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之分析」所載業務說明一併考量。這些風險為本公司所知之重大風險。若下列或本年度10-K表報中所載，或隨後公開檔中所提及之事件或發展發生，可能對本公司之業務、財務狀況、營運成果及現金流造成重大不利影響。

本公司之業務、財務狀況、營運成果及現金流可能因全球經濟條件變動及地緣政治風險而受到負面影響，包括信貸市場條件、貿易政策、包括近期宣佈及潛在增加之特定原材料關稅、消費者與企業信心水準、商品價格與供應量、通貨膨脹壓力、匯率、政府支出與財赤水準、政治條件，以及其他可能影響全球經濟之挑戰，包括中東地區持續衝突，以及因俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭而施加之經濟制裁所產生之影響。這些經濟與地緣政治條件可能以多種方式影響如本公司之企業。這些條件可能對本公司應變變動經濟與業務條件之靈活性，以及資金營運、透過營運成長或重新融資到期債務之能力造成負面影響。此外，信貸取得限制可能影響客戶取得重大採購之融資能力，並導致產品與服務之訂單減少或取消，以及影響客戶付款能力。同樣地，信貸限制可能影響本公司之供應商羣體，並增加一個或多個供應商遭遇財務困難或破產之潛在風險。請參閱「與本公司應報告分部相關之特定風險」。
本公司銷售之相當大一部分受市場條件影響，可能導致客戶對本公司產品之需求波動。這些產業之需求減少將導致受影響之業務分部之銷售與利潤減少。

•在本公司之航空與先進科技分部，航空旅行需求顯著下降，或航空公司整體獲利能力下降，可能導致飛機訂單減少，並可能導致航空公司減少從本公司業務購買新零件。此外，若本公司主要飛機製造客戶遭遇問題，影響其生產速率，並相應減少本公司產品之採購，或因航空公司客戶之價格壓力導致製造商要求供應商降低價格和/或延長付款條件，則本公司之航空與先進科技分部可能受到影響；此外，軍事與防禦產品之需求取決於特定領域之政府支出，而該支出可能每年有所變動。
•本公司之流程技術分部依賴全球經濟條件、客戶資本支出與商品價格。任何這些經濟因素之惡化，可能導致銷售與利潤低於目前預期。
